name: Permanent Resident's Certificate (PRC)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being ordinarily resident in Bermuda for at least 20 years, including the 2 years immediately preceding the application; reduced to 15 years for a non-Bermudian parent of a Bermudian child.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 20 years of ordinary residence in Bermuda (or 15 years if a non-Bermudian parent of a Bermudian child), including the 2 years immediately preceding application.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be at least 18 years old and demonstrate good conduct and character.
Requires being exempted from immigration restrictions under the Economic Development Act for at least 10 years, including the 2 years immediately preceding the application.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old and demonstrate good conduct and character.

requirement_groups.name: Family relation to a PRC holder (Sections 31ZA/31ZB)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the son, daughter, or spouse of a person who already holds a Permanent Resident's Certificate.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old and demonstrate good conduct and character.

evidence_required.document: Proof of ordinary residence period, or Economic Development Act exemption period, or family relationship to a PRC holder
Application submitted with bank-transfer payment confirmation (no cash or credit cards accepted)

sources.title: Government of Bermuda -- Permanent Resident's Certificate Application: three qualifying tracks (Section 31B general residence, Section 31A Economic Development Act exemption, Sections 31ZA/31ZB family relation), fee schedule

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Bermuda's initial build. Modelled as three OR-groups matching the Act's own distinct statutory sections and dramatically different fees (Section 31A at $50,000 vs. Section 31B at $3,310 vs. Sections 31ZA/31ZB at $10,000 each) -- these are genuinely different qualifying mechanisms (long residence, investment-linked economic exemption, and family derivation), not variations of one rule. The 15-year reduced threshold for a non-Bermudian parent of a Bermudian child is folded into the general_residence group as an alternative within the same Section 31B fee tier, since the source did not indicate a different fee for that sub-case -- flagged as an assumption. leads_to_citizenship is false: this is Bermuda's general permanent-residence status, separate from both 'Bermudian status' (the local status -- see bm_status_descent.json) and British Overseas Territories Citizenship (bm_naturalisation_botc.json). switchable_to points to bm_naturalisation_botc.json since British Naturalisation's fee is billed through the same Department of Immigration schedule as this certificate, suggesting (not confirmed) that PRC holders are the natural applicant pool for that route.
